scientific_scope_status: Actually fit independent native polynomial programs G_i of degree<=D on F_p^n, p>2(D+1), while each fixed real basis source f_i remains available for its own fresh guards. Aggregate guards certify sum_i disagreement(f_i,G_i)<=eta on a joint confidence event; hence every linear combination agrees outside one common exceptional region of mass<=eta. After old sources expire, actual random-line correction on a new source within tau of that family recovers its coefficients using r(D+1)L source values when eta+tau<=1/[8(D+1)]. New tolerant target guards retain open-world soundness; useful coverage remains conditional.
